tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search Drone Intelligence briefings, market intelligence pages, company profiles and comparisons. Returns up to 10 matches with title, type, URL and excerpt.

tools.name: get_briefing
tools.description: Full text of a Drone Intelligence Signal Dossier briefing by slug: executive summary, signals, assessment, sources.

tools.name: get_intelligence_page
tools.description: A Drone Intelligence market intelligence page by slug: overview, sections, key players, outlook, sources.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: A Drone Intelligence company profile by slug: positioning, sourced facts, funding, contracts, products.

tools.name: compare_companies
tools.description: A Drone Intelligence side-by-side company comparison by slug, e.g. droneshield-vs-dedrone.

tools.name: list_catalogue
tools.description: Paginated slugs of Drone Intelligence content by type (briefing, intelligence, company, comparison). 50 per page.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: The commercial products, machine-readable: what they are, prices, checkout URLs, licence terms.

tools.name: tracker_schema
tools.description: Metadata for the paid Counter-UAS Tracker dataset: fields, theatres, layers, counts, data-through date, licence. Requires a tracker licence token.

tools.name: tracker_awards
tools.description: Query the 76 sourced counter-UAS awards. Filter by theatre, kill-chain layer, or awardee substring. Requires a tracker licence token.

tools.name: tracker_vendor_matrix
tools.description: Query the 45-vendor counter-UAS competitive matrix. Filter by layer or US-procurement eligibility. Requires a tracker licence token.

tools.name: tracker_capital_ledger
tools.description: The tracker's capital and acquisition ledger: where the money behind the counter-UAS vendors is being raised. Requires a tracker licence token.

tools.name: tracker_aggregate
tools.description: Counts of tracker awards grouped by theatre, layer, or awardee. Requires a tracker licence token.
